svg.title: Samagra OS
svg.desc: Samagra OS: a real x86-64 operating system built from first principles. Boot stages light in sequence, physical page frames fill a memory map and a preemptive scheduler slices time across kernel tasks. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: Long mode, paging, interrupts, a preemptive
scheduler, early Ring 3 and system calls.
